items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Because I remember that one night we had Charlie Parker on the bill.

ctx.x: Well anyway -- Because I remember that one night we had Charlie Parker on the bill. And all these kids came over from the school -- college kids came over. About five hundred and they stayed outside. They wasn't gonna go in until The Bird in. (inaudible). "We aint' going in until The Bird fly in."
The Bird flew in, then all -- Well it was about a dollar to get in -- that's all. Two dollars to get in, something like that.
